texts.b516959fc62f: GHG/BMI is a provider of NHS care to both the primary and secondary care area. At present we work with over 110 PCTs and have 56 BMI sites offering Choose and Book services. GHG/BMI are working closely with the NHS to both improve and look at new pathways to support the ever increasing need for efficiency and deliver value for money services. By GHG/BMI having access to this data, it will allow us to complete analysis when looking at services closure to relevant community settings. It will also let us look at the other ways of working, and partnering with other services to make sure patients experience and care is at the front of the decision making process. Data is a crucial part to play and as a company we understand with having a CDS quality rate of 99.5%, it is imperative to make sure the data we supplied can help others as well in delivering great services The data will be processed within the IMU department as mentioned above, but for internal purposes only. If there was to be any publications then GHG would seek approval from the IC. If any graphs and documents are produced internally the source of data would be clearly identified on the report. There could also be the need for mapping services and looking at foot print of services, to which this would just be a data set loaded in to visualise the importance of new services.
